shared_elements: carved relief on a vertical stone slab/pillar surface
fine repeated incised linear marks (finger-like lines in A, rows of wedge signs in B)
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces bear shallow incised/relief marking on an upright rectangular stone field, with repeated fine linear strokes. A depicts a figural scheme — a bent arm with splayed fingers in low relief and a projecting sculpted animal-head/knob on a belt-like band — whereas B depicts nothing but dense, uniform ruled columns of script signs, with no figures, creatures or objects at all.
